answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fakes from flooding paid work. The queue is a narrow ridge of 200 slots: claiming one burns a 50-credit deposit and hangs a public lantern on it. A spot check on the knoll re-tests the holder; idle or fake, the deposit stays burned and the slot returns to the queue. Forging 100 identities burns 100 deposits, 5,000 credits, before earning anything. The honest agent pays 50 once and keeps the slot's full reward.
